voice.//wakeEngine: auto = Porcupine .ppn or openWakeWord .onnx if wakeKeywordPath points at one, else the built-in template spotter (models/wake/templates.json, `npm run enroll`), else the transcript matcher. Also: porcupine | onnx | template | whisper | none.
voice.//vadModel: Silero VAD (MIT). Empty = RMS level detection.
voice.//sttStreaming: Transcribe WHILE you speak (Sarvam realtime WebSocket); the transcript is final within ~0.5 s of your last word instead of after a file round trip. sttProvider 'apple' (on-device, en/hi) needs NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription in the packaged app's Info.plist and falls back to the file path otherwise.
voice.//ttsStreaming: Speak sentence by sentence as the model writes, through the persistent native/voiceio player. Off = the old fetch-whole-file-then-afplay path.
voice.//captureEngine: auto = the voiceio helper's echo-cancelled microphone when it runs (barge-in on speakers), pvrecorder = the plain mic.
voice.//maxSpokenSentences: Spoken replies longer than this are cut with 'The rest is on screen.' 0 = never.

//memory: The Memory OS. importLegacy folds the old memories.jsonl/episodic files in once (a copy; the originals stay). cloudRecall=false stops recalled memory being sent to a cloud brain — the current task's own state still is, and the local brain is unaffected. Screen/scan-derived and sensitive content is never sent to a cloud model either way. retentionDays expires consolidated episodes created after you switch it on; 0 keeps them until forgotten.
